items.summary: Implement a minimal, reusable error-toast helper that shows a top-right toast for errors with: (1) gold border, (2) pearl off-white text color #F5F5F0, and (3) automatic fade-out after 4 seconds. Use English text and a default message format like "Error: Please try again".

Wire the new basic error toast into existing error paths without changing routing/auth flow/UI layout: show the toast on invalid OTP entry, OTP send/verify failures, Internet Identity login failures, and dashboard profile save failures (including network/actor errors).

Keep the change minimal: do not add a notification bell, do not implement rate limiting, and do not add heavy logic. Preserve the existing theme, hover effects, and dashboard layout; do not change SPA routing or authentication flow.

After implementing and deploying the update, provide the draft URL and confirm via a short checklist: (1) no blank screen on login, (2) error toast is visible when triggered (wrong OTP or failed save), and (3) UI is stable.
